ownershipCoverage.rule: Main players are those projected above 0 points who are not listed out and not only a DraftKings-average stand-in; a source is used when the players it names hold at least 80% of their total projected points.

recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of TwoGun x1, TwoGun's own DraftKings projection, used as he publishes it. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage falls back to the DraftKings average points per game, flagged "no projection", unless the injury report lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection is 0; with no average it stays blank rather than zero.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)
